definitions.explanation: A question word asking to identify one item from a group of three or more. Used when choices are not directly attached to nouns.

examples.japanese: ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かばん→かばん：00637_kaban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どれ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
どれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: Which one do you like the best?

examples.japanese: どれ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Any one is fine, so please choose the one you like.
examples.notes: どれ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ = any one (of them)

examples.japanese: ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧どれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: There are many smartphones, but which one of these is the most popular?

examples.japanese: ⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、どれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{決|き}められない→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦もらいました→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: There are many cakes, but I couldn't decide which one I wanted to eat, so I had my friend choose for me.

notes:
どれ is a question word for selecting one item from three or more options.

KO-SO-A-DO SYSTEM:
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧: this one (near speaker)
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧: that one (near listener)
- ⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧: that one over there (far from both)
- どれ: which one? (question)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧〜: which one is the most ~?
- どれ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧: any one (of them)
- どれ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: any one is fine

USAGE:
For two items, use ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧ instead. どれ implies three or more choices.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧ + noun: which ~ (attributive form)
